entry.content:
Joaquin Phoenix headlines a short film by Jonathan Glazer introducing Gentle Monster's first Intelligent Eyewear collection. Glazer is known for directing Under the Skin, a frequent pick for best film of the 2010s, and the Academy Award-winning The Zone of Interest. Phoenix plays a salesman drifting through a surreal hotel, where the eyewear becomes his way to communicate with unfamiliar entities. The Intelligent Eyewear collection fits Google's Android XR and Gemini assistant into the Seoul brand's frames. Gemini speaks to the wearer through built-in speakers, with no display, and the glasses connect to Android phones and iPhones alike.

entry.summary: Jay Ahr's Ballet Mécanique, named for Fernand Léger's 1924 film, is a Sotheby's selling exhibition of vintage objects transformed by the Paris studio, and the studio's first major showing of automotive work. The centerpiece is three Rolls-Royce Corniche Coupés from the 72 Ahr has
entry.content:
Jay Ahr's Ballet Mécanique, named for Fernand Léger's 1924 film, is a Sotheby's selling exhibition of vintage objects transformed by the Paris studio, and the studio's first major showing of automotive work. The centerpiece is three Rolls-Royce Corniche Coupés from the 72 Ahr has collected, each taken apart into more than 70,000 pieces and reassembled in more than a year, including a 1975 coupé with a GM V-8 and a 1981 coupé with a split rear window. Around them sit Louis Vuitton Keepalls and Hermès Kelly and Birkin bags embroidered or woven with motifs from the places and years they were made, plus Jean Prouvé beds that Ahr reengineered to double as a bench or a table.

entry.content:
Designed for comfortable cruising on everything from city streets to gravel roads, HIMIWAY's D5 2.0 20-inch e-bike pairs a full-suspension setup with a compact, easy-to-mount frame. A 750W motor delivers 90Nm of torque for confident hill climbing, while switchable torque and cadence sensor modes let riders choose between a more natural feel and effortless assistance. Its upright riding position, 400-pound payload capacity, and cushioned suspension make it a comfortable option for longer outings, whether navigating pavement, gravel roads, or exploring from a campsite or RV. entry.summary: Tineco's FLOOR ONE S9 Artist combines cordless vacuuming, mopping, and high-temperature steam cleaning into a single floor-care system. Its HyperSteam technology heats steam to 320°F to tackle stubborn grease, dried spills, and embedded grime, while 22kPa suction picks up wet and
entry.content:
Tineco's FLOOR ONE S9 Artist combines cordless vacuuming, mopping, and high-temperature steam cleaning into a single floor-care system. Its HyperSteam technology heats steam to 320°F to tackle stubborn grease, dried spills, and embedded grime, while 22kPa suction picks up wet and dry messes in a single pass. An iLoop smart sensor automatically adjusts suction and water flow based on floor conditions, and the 180-degree lay-flat design reaches underneath furniture and into tight spaces. DualBlock anti-tangle technology helps manage pet hair, triple-sided edge cleaning gets closer to baseboards, and the FlashDry self-cleaning system washes the brush roller before drying it with 185°F hot air. With up to 75 minutes of runtime in Auto mode, the S9 Artist Steam makes a compelling case for retiring the traditional mop and vacuum routine.

entry.content:
Arc'teryx made the Kragg Mid for the downtime at basecamp between serious treks or climbs: a pull-on shoe that serves as approach hiker, belay shoe and camp slipper. The mid-height collar helps shut out debris for forays into the woods, and the Betaspun wool upper keeps feet warm when temps drop. A revised fit gives toes more room and holds the midfoot in place. The PU drop-in midsole sits over a Vibram Megagrip outsole for grip on rock and snow, and a molded rubber toe cap protects the toes.

entry.content:
Classic Recreations hand-crafts every panel of the 1967-68 Shelby GT500CR from aerospace-grade carbon fiber, making it the only carbon-fiber 1967-68 GT500 with Shelby's official license. The proportions match the original, with less weight underneath. A Ford Performance Coyote 5.0-liter V8 comes in three stages: about 500 horsepower naturally aspirated, 700 with a Whipple supercharger, and 900 with a Wegner-built engine and the same blower. Buyers pick a 10-speed automatic or a six-speed Tremec manual. Detroit Speed supplies the rear suspension, tubular sub-frame connectors brace the chassis, and a side-exit exhaust ends in stainless tips. Inside, Focal speakers, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto join hand-stitched leather seats. Each car gets its own serial number and a spot in the Shelby American Worldwide Registry.

entry.content:
A weekend in the Great Smoky Mountains and a trek through the Peruvian Andes have one thing in common: the need for gear built to go the distance. GORUCK's GR2 combines military-inspired durability with suitcase-like organization. Modeled after Special Forces medical rucks, its rugged Cordura construction opens completely flat for easy accessibility while remaining carry-on compliant. Two main compartments provide organizational pockets, including a reinforced laptop compartment. Extra-padded shoulder straps and a removable frame sheet support heavier loads, while YKK zippers feature silent, glove-friendly pulls made from parachute cord. Internal and external MOLLE webbing allows for customization, making the GR2 suited for travel, outdoor adventures, and everyday commuting.

entry.content:
Sony's MDR-3R revives the headphones that came with the first Walkman, down to the curved headband, the perforated sound holes and the "Dynamic Stereo Headphones" lettering. The open-back on-ear pair keeps the original's 0.9-inch drivers and weighs about 1.3 ounces without the cable. Both blue and orange earpads come in the box, and the pads swap out. The big change is the cord: a 4-foot Y-cable, serrated to resist tangles, ends in a USB-C plug that fits phones, tablets and laptops, with an inline mic and remote for calls, volume and track skipping. Nothing to charge, nothing to pair, and the packaging is plastic-free.
